commit_subjects: C16 route watch: look along stale return routes while searching
C9 camera map linking: carry visual keyframes and share candidate agreement
C9 place recognition feeds frame linking: verify camera poses without blocking ticks
git_metadata_status: Shared worktree HEAD.lock and index.lock writes denied. Commits are preserved in a separate local Git database and exported as c9-c16-integration.bundle; the requested branch remains at 06adcfc.
merge_provenance: Each staged full file was diffed against dcb6a61 and merged into current sources. BrainConfig validation combined both packages with lidar_open_span_deg. All 139 nonblank added lines from 06adcfc were checked verbatim in the final source.

route_watch.reason: Keep the existing search behaviour unless enabled for comparison. Held-out run 1 saw no fire cells from 96 to 116 s while the route home burned; the robot turned at 120 s and the way out closed 0.2 s later.

route_watch_stale_s.reason: Held-out run 1 missed route fire for at least 20 s from 96 to 116 s. A 15 s stale look threshold checks before that measured blind interval.

route_watch_max_stale_share.reason: Require a majority of the route beyond escape_ignore_m to be unseen for 15 s. Held-out run 1 missed the fire along that route for 20 s; one unobserved cell should not turn the robot.

route_watch_min_interval_s.reason: Bound routine interruptions to one per 90 s. Held-out run 1 first needed the look during the 96 to 116 s blind interval; the 12 s cap then costs at most 12/90 of search time.

route_watch_dwell_s.reason: The closing-rate rule needs two intervals of escape_check_s=2 s after seeing fire. A 4.5 s dwell provides both plus 0.5 s for image delivery.

route_watch_max_s.reason: At sweep_yaw_dps=45 a half turn needs 4 s, plus the 4.5 s dwell. A 12 s cap leaves 3.5 s for heading convergence and delayed images without an unbounded stop.

visual_keyframe_period_s.reason: How often a robot asks its own OpenCV 5 place service for a camera keyframe (ORB features with positions). One per radio broadcast (2 s): at 0.3 to 0.5 m/s that is a keyframe every 0.6 to 1 m, closer than the 1.5 m within which two cameras still share most of a view.

visual_keyframe_max.reason: Own camera keyframes kept for sending (400 s of keyframes at one per 2 s, longer than a run).

visual_keyframes_per_message.reason: Send at most one 96-feature visual keyframe per broadcast, newest first and older views in turn. Its payload is 3653 bytes; with one LiDAR sweep MessageByteLimitsUseActualBinaryRoundTripsAtHouseScale measured full 7975 bytes and delta 7407 bytes.

visual_link_min_inliers.reason: Match the service floor in config/perception.json. place_eval database mode rejected the worst wrong checkerboard/tile match with 15 inliers by requiring 16. The measured evaluation had 0 false accepts in about 58000 negatives. Map verification and two separated candidates still apply.

visual_place_linking.reason: Enable camera proposals from the measured ORB service. tools/place_eval.py recorded 0 false accepts in about 58000 negative pairs, 4.6 percent cross-robot recall, and 2.4 cm median pose error. LiDAR map fit, uniqueness, and two separated agreeing candidates still gate every link.

visual_lidar_keyframes_per_message.reason: MessageByteLimitsUseActualBinaryRoundTripsAtHouseScale measured an 8165-byte delta with two 360-beam LiDAR sweeps and one 96-feature visual payload, above 8000 bytes. One sweep near the visual capture pose supports map verification even after a delayed service reply. The test measured 7407-byte deltas and 7975-byte full snapshots; LiDAR-only messages still carry two.

visual_keyframe_max_payload_bytes.reason: The measured service uses 96 ORB features at 38 bytes each plus a 5-byte header, exactly 3653 bytes. Reject larger service payloads until the radio budget is measured again; the one-sweep house delta measured 7407 bytes.

place_http_timeout_s.reason: Keyframe extraction measured at most 0.35 s and matching about 10 ms in tools/place_eval.py. A 2 s client deadline allows over five times the measured extraction time. The recorder polls asynchronously and continues after timeout; the worker process has its own 30 s recovery bound.

managed_tests.scope: BrainTests and RouteWatchTests via standalone NUnit and Unity managed DLLs; Unity was not launched. Other EditMode fixtures were compiled only.
not_executed: StepCostProbe is an explicit timing probe

python_tests.command: cd brain && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/smoke-rescue-uv-cache UV_NO_SYNC=1 PYTEST_ADDOPTS=--tb=short uv run pytest -q
python_tests.failure_reason: 24 indoor recorded-data cases and 2 recorded map3d cases require data/recordings/unity_house_hidden_run1, which is absent in this worktree. Main-tree recordings were not read.
python_tests.environment_limit: Network disabled; locked transformers 5.20.2 was not cached. Tests used a local environment assembled from compatible cached wheels, including Python 3.11.15, OpenCV 5.0.0.93, NumPy 2.4.6 and pytest 9.1.1. Dependency files were not changed.

radio_bytes.visual_payload_formula: 5-byte header + 96 * (32 descriptor bytes + 3 int16 centimetre coordinates)

radio.new_tail_after_CarriedOut: int32 VisualKeyframes count, then for each: int32 id, float32 position.x, float32 position.y, float32 yawRad, uint16 payload length, raw payload bytes. BinaryWriter little-endian. Count is always present, including zero.
radio.bounds: Decoder count <=16 and payload <=8192 bytes; runtime config rejects visual payloads above 3653 bytes before matching. Older versions and truncated packets are dropped and logged by OnPeerPacket.
radio.inner_payload_unchanged: VP magic, uint8 version=1, uint16 feature count, then 32 descriptor bytes and int16 x/right, y/forward, height/up in centimetres per feature.
radio.id_semantics: Radio visual ids are monotone per robot/run. The recorder maps service ids into these ids and never reuses a radio id after a service restart.

http.POST /place/{robot}/keyframe: Request unchanged {robot_dir,t}. Successful replies add database_id and t, the actual RGB image stamp, to {ok,id,features,payload_b64}. Ordinary ok=false replies also add database_id.
http.POST /place/{robot}/match: Request unchanged {robot_dir,t,payload_b64}. Both matched and unmatched replies add database_id. Pose, mine_id, inliers and rmse fields retain their meanings.
http.database_id: UUID hex string unique to a PlaceDatabase generation; changes when the run resets or a worker restarts. Client refuses unknown generations and requires the exact recorder image stamp.

decision_events.frame_linked: fit becomes score; descriptor_distance is removed from this event; adds visual, a count from 0 to 2. dx_m,dy_m,dyaw_deg,candidates remain. score is LiDAR fit or camera inlier count according to source.
decision_events.place_recognised: fit becomes score. Common pose/link coordinates remain. LiDAR adds descriptor_distance and shift; camera adds inliers. Reasons name the sensor.

new_events.place_service: Reason text for HTTP, malformed-response, stale-frame and worker-generation failures.

decision_events.peer_message_rejected: Existing kind also covers old/truncated byte packets and invalid visual metadata.

new_editmode_tests.name: ARobotSearchingWithItsBackToTheRouteHomeTurnsToLookAlongIt
new_editmode_tests.checks: Turns toward stale home route, holds, and refreshes thermal look times.
new_editmode_tests.control: WithRouteWatchOffNoLookStarts repeats the same walk with route_watch=false.

new_editmode_tests.name: ARobotWhoseThermalCameraRecentlyLookedAlongTheRouteDoesNotTurnBack
new_editmode_tests.checks: Fresh cool-floor thermal observations suppress a route look.
new_editmode_tests.control: The same walk facing away starts a look; cool readings do not add heat.

new_editmode_tests.name: WithRouteWatchOffNoLookStarts
new_editmode_tests.checks: Disabled route watch leaves the route unseen and never turns back.
new_editmode_tests.control: The enabled walk starts a look.

new_editmode_tests.name: AHeatRetreatCancelsALookAndNoLookStartsWhileRetreating
new_editmode_tests.checks: Heat retreat cancels a look on the same step and prevents another.
new_editmode_tests.control: Hot from the start never starts a look; the cool walk starts and finishes one.

new_editmode_tests.name: AfterTheLookTheRobotResumesItsPreviousGoal
new_editmode_tests.checks: Keeps the frontier path and goal through the look, then turns back.
new_editmode_tests.control: The feature-off walk retains the previous exploration behavior.

new_editmode_tests.name: CarryingAPersonDoesNotStartARouteLook
new_editmode_tests.checks: Carrying suppresses route watch.
new_editmode_tests.control: Identical safe exploration starts a look; both feature-on and feature-off carrying stay quiet.

new_editmode_tests.name: ReturningDoesNotStartARouteLook
new_editmode_tests.checks: A returning robot does not start a route look.
new_editmode_tests.control: Identical safe exploration starts a look; both feature-on and feature-off returning stay quiet.

new_editmode_tests.name: LowHeatBudgetDoesNotStartARouteLook
new_editmode_tests.checks: Low heat budget cannot start a look before the retreat branch runs.
new_editmode_tests.control: Identical full-budget exploration starts a look; feature-off stays quiet.

new_editmode_tests.name: UnknownRouteHomeDoesNotStartARouteLook
new_editmode_tests.checks: An obstructed, unknown route home cannot trigger a look.
new_editmode_tests.control: The same mapped walk with a known route starts a look; feature-off stays quiet.

new_editmode_tests.name: CameraMatchesWithoutALidarMapNeverBecomeLinkCandidates
new_editmode_tests.checks: RANSAC matches cannot create candidates without an own LiDAR map.
new_editmode_tests.control: The same two views with a measured LiDAR map link.

new_editmode_tests.name: RepeatingCorridorCameraMatchesFailTheLidarUniquenessTest
new_editmode_tests.checks: A repeated corridor fails shifted-sweep uniqueness even after a camera match.
new_editmode_tests.control: An asymmetric room with off-centre pillars links.

new_editmode_tests.name: CameraRansacDisagreeingWithALidarCandidateCannotLink
new_editmode_tests.checks: Two camera transforms agreeing with each other but 0.5 m from the LiDAR placement cannot link.
new_editmode_tests.control: An agreeing camera candidate links with the existing LiDAR candidate.

new_editmode_tests.name: CameraMatchCannotReplaceAnExistingFrameLink
new_editmode_tests.checks: Later camera callbacks and shared-accumulator calls cannot replace an established transform.
new_editmode_tests.control: The feature-off scene never establishes a link.

new_editmode_tests.name: CameraMatchesNeedSeparatedPartnerPlacesAndEnoughInliers
new_editmode_tests.checks: Near-duplicate places and insufficient RANSAC inliers cannot link.
new_editmode_tests.control: Separated views with enough inliers link.

new_editmode_tests.name: OldAndTruncatedRadioPacketsAreDroppedAndLogged
new_editmode_tests.checks: Version 3, empty and several truncated packets are rejected without an exception or peer-state changes.
new_editmode_tests.control: The old direct decoder throws on the same inputs; a complete version 4 packet is accepted.

new_editmode_tests.name: CameraPacketsCarryANearbyLidarSweepWithinTheByteBudget
new_editmode_tests.checks: Camera-bearing packets carry one sweep near the visual capture, including delayed older captures.
new_editmode_tests.control: LiDAR-only packets keep two sweeps; a fresh visual capture gets the newest nearby sweep.

new_editmode_tests.name: VisualOnlyPacketsAreResentAndCallerPayloadsAreDetached
new_editmode_tests.checks: Visual-only broadcasts are retried and input/output array mutations cannot alter retained fingerprints.
new_editmode_tests.control: An idle robot without visual data emits no delta.

new_editmode_tests.name: PartnerVisualWorkIsBoundedAndRetriedWhenAnOwnViewArrives
new_editmode_tests.checks: Bounds pending work, retries retained partner views after a new own view, and detaches drained payloads.
new_editmode_tests.control: Draining without a new view does not requeue work.

new_editmode_tests.name: InvalidVisualPoseOrOversizePayloadIsRejectedBeforeMatching
new_editmode_tests.checks: Nonfinite visual pose and 97-feature payloads are rejected before queuing matches.
new_editmode_tests.control: Valid camera and LiDAR metadata is accepted.

new_editmode_tests.name: CameraVerificationUsesTheSamePerStepBudgetAsLidar
new_editmode_tests.checks: A one-verification step cannot verify a second camera candidate.
new_editmode_tests.control: A fresh step admits it and links.

new_editmode_tests.name: PlaceServiceDownOrSlowDoesNotBlockTheRecorderPump
new_editmode_tests.checks: Unavailable and slow HTTP requests end through connection failure or the configured cancellation timeout and log an error.
new_editmode_tests.control: The disabled feature makes no HTTP requests.

new_editmode_tests.name: PlaceServiceRepliesFeedTheVerifiedFrameLinkPath
new_editmode_tests.checks: HTTP keyframes and matches reach OnVisualPlaceMatch and the map-verified shared accumulator.
new_editmode_tests.control: One HTTP match still does not link; the second independent match does.

new_editmode_tests.name: PlaceWorkerRestartAndStaleFrameRepliesCannotReuseOldPoses
new_editmode_tests.checks: Service restarts get fresh radio ids, and a reply for another image cannot inherit the capture pose.
new_editmode_tests.control: A valid exact-stamp reply updates the keyframe; a stale stamp leaves it unchanged.

new_editmode_tests.name: MalformedPlaceResponsesAreLoggedWithoutStoppingThePump
new_editmode_tests.checks: Malformed JSON and missing required fields log errors without stopping polling.
new_editmode_tests.control: Disabled capture makes no request.

new_editmode_tests.name: AnUnfinishedPlaceRequestDoesNotBlockCaptureOrPolling
new_editmode_tests.checks: An unresolved response gate does not block starting a capture or polling completion.
new_editmode_tests.control: Releasing the gate allows the completed response to be applied.

new_editmode_tests.name: ASubsecondCameraReplyUsesTheRecordersExactImageStamp
new_editmode_tests.checks: A capture at 2 + 1/15 s accepts the recorder index stamp 2.066667 and keeps the capture pose.
new_editmode_tests.control: Disabled capture leaves the old result; stale stamps are rejected by the restart/stale-frame test.

new_editmode_tests.name: TwoAgreeingCameraPlaceMatchesLinkTheFramesAndOneOrAConflictDoesNot
new_editmode_tests.checks: Two verified, separated camera candidates recover a rotated/translated frame and apply waiting partner map and survivor content.
new_editmode_tests.control: One candidate, a conflicting pose, and visual_place_linking=false do not link; partner content stays withheld before linking.

new_editmode_tests.name: CameraKeyframesSurviveTheRadioFormat
new_editmode_tests.checks: Version 4 preserves visual id, pose and all payload bytes.
new_editmode_tests.control: A packet without visual keyframes decodes to an empty array.

new_python_tests.name: test_database_identity_changes_when_service_ids_restart
new_python_tests.checks: Database identity changes across reset/restart, service ids restart, actual image stamp and identity reach both endpoints.
new_python_tests.control: Consecutive keyframes in the same database retain identity; a new database differs.

new_python_tests.name: test_repeated_texture_descriptors_cannot_fix_a_place_pose
new_python_tests.checks: Repeated descriptors fail the existing ratio/one-to-one matcher even with matching 3D geometry.
new_python_tests.control: Distinct descriptors at the same positions self-match with 96 inliers.
new_python_tests.revert_note: Existing matcher behavior; no production matcher change. The new C# uniqueness guard has its own removal check.

new_python_tests.name: test_place_endpoints_report_worker_failure_as_unavailable
new_python_tests.checks: A place worker failure returns HTTP 503.
new_python_tests.control: An ordinary no-feature response returns HTTP 200 with ok=false.
new_python_tests.revert_note: Existing server error mapping; no production error-handler change. New HTTP cancellation and nonblocking behavior have C# removal checks.
